info.title: HardBasis Public API
info.description: Generated from the gateway's Zod contracts (PAPI-4). Money crosses the wire as decimal STRINGS — see `x-hardbasis-unit`; never parse a `…Msat`/`…Q8`/`…Q9`/`…TsMs`/`…contracts` field as a JSON number.
